symbol_or_anchor: loadStore() — "return null" in the readFileSync/JSON.parse catch, consumed by "Could not read store.json, allowing dispatch"
quote: try { return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(storePath, "utf8")); } catch { return null; }
why_debt: this PreToolUse builder-dispatch gate conflates store.json being ABSENT with store.json being CORRUPT into the same null->allow-with-warning path, so a corrupted (not just missing) gate-check ledger silently disables the entire dependency gate for every builder dispatch instead of failing closed.

symbol_or_anchor: main stdin handler — "No store — can't verify, allow with warning"
why_debt: the companion gauntlet-dependency PreToolUse gate (live-wired alongside gate-check.js in .claude/settings.json) allows any builder dispatch outright when the oneshot store is absent, so a deleted/never-initialized store bypasses the mechanism whose entire job is to mechanically refuse dispatch until dependencies pass their gauntlet review.

symbol_or_anchor: main() — "runner error -> never trap the session"
quote: if (!res) process.exit(0); // runner error → never trap the session
why_debt: a crash/throw in scripts/trackers/validate.js is indistinguishable from a clean GREEN tracker: both exit 0 silently, even when TRACKER_GATE_ENFORCE=1 is set, so a broken validator (not just a missing TRACKER.md) never blocks session end on a RED/unreconciled tracker.

symbol_or_anchor: R-id trace-integrity check (WG-7) — outer catch "fail-open for unexpected errors"
why_debt: the function's own inline logic explicitly hardens this check to FAIL-CLOSED when granular-stories.md/trace.md cite R-ids the PRD never defines (born-broken traceability), but any unrelated runtime exception during that same check (encoding error, race on the file reads, a regex/matchAll bug) is swallowed by the outer catch into ok:true, silently undoing the fail-closed guarantee the comment claims.

symbol_or_anchor: isGated() precondition guard, repeated in every test()
quote: if (await isGated(page)) test.skip(true, "no founder session provisioned");
why_debt: all six tests in this design-quality-gauntlet spec self-skip (reading as PASS in most CI/test-runner summaries) whenever the harness has not provisioned a founder session, and several of the remaining assertions are themselves wrapped in `if (count > 0)` guards — so a harness that never establishes the session, or a page that never renders the guarded elements, produces a fully green spec file that asserted nothing about AC-A4/A5/A8.
